series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

evidence.sentence: 119 084,45 82 157,35 64 682,29 34 932,61 2010 2020 2025 2030 Emissions hors foresterie Fig. 3 : Tendance des Emissions (en Gg Eq CO2) dans le scénario Business as Usual 4.3 Portée et couverture des actions d'atténuation Dans le scénario CDN avec prise en compte des mesures, l'augmentation des émissions est contenue à 104 187 Gg Eq CO2 en 2030 soit une hausse de 66 % par rapport à 2010 (34 933 Gg Eq CO2) et une réduction de 12 % par rapport au scénario BAU.

Dans ce même scénario, mais cette fois avec mesures additionnelles, l'augmentation des émissions est contenue à 76 826 Gg Eq CO2 en 2030 soit une augmentation de 55 % par rapport à 2010 et une réduction de 35 % par rapport au scénario BAU ce qui représente en valeur absolue 42 259 Gg Eq CO2 de réduction (Fig.4).

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2026-06-17. 48 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (2). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 64.8 MtCO₂e, DS-02 48.8 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. ND-GAIN scores it 39.9 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 32% reduction in GHG emissions for 2035 compared to a reference scenario It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.1°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.97°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
